## Purpose

Describe the repository assessment, decision, scaffold, adapter, fork, or clean-room work package.

## Evidence

- Upstream repository:
- Pinned revision:
- Assessment:
- Decision record:
- License and NOTICE review:

## Change type

- [ ] Catalog or research only
- [ ] Assessment completed
- [ ] Decision record

## Gates

- [ ] No secrets, private source, production data, or proprietary assets
- [ ] License and attribution requirements preserved

- [ ] Target product boundary is explicit
- [ ] Security impact reviewed

- [ ] THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES updated when distribution is affected
